method: Every AST function joined to explicit source-read contracts; initializer read as whole module.

contract.claim: Checks exact shape/float or bool dtype/finiteness; returns independent detached clone.
Numeric scalar excludes bool, validates finite and optional positivity.
Whitelist copies own state, LiDAR and tracker/camera data; computes xyzw yaw; validates calibration/ranges.
Independent N-first zero state using reference dtype/device.
Updates camera-only misses/acquisition once; current terminal mask, INTERCEPT and PRE precedence.
Finite feasible F minus best; +inf for unavailable F with alternative;0 sentinel if none.
Safety/gain/dwell arbitration, feasible argmin or hold slot1; exact four-result API and new state.
Validates finite positive numeric dt seconds.
Validates integer positive sample/step count.
Restricts finite float32/64 tensor.
Checks dimensions, scale-aware symmetry/PSD; returns symmetric average.
Checks N,6 mean and N,6,6 covariance dtype/device.
Checks6,6 or N,6,6 PSD Q and broadcasts per env.
Reproduces diagonal .025dt² position and .25dt velocity process variances.
Recurses deterministic CV means and FPFᵀ+Q from t+dt to t+Hdt.
Per-env Cholesky retries with explicit recorded diagonal jitter.
Initial Gaussian belief plus independent per-step Q increments; explicit local Generator advances.
Prior/Joseph-posterior convex mixture; exact original at p=0; singular innovation fails closed.
Boolean segment clearance against per-env valid points.
Produces20 deterministic normalized candidate commands and family/fallback diagnostics.
Cholesky logdet; symmetric finite strictly PD required, no hidden entropy floor.
Computes five specified scalar utilities and mode weights; masks infeasible/nonfinite scores to+inf.

contract.name: RiskcapConfig.__post_init__
contract.input_output: Frozen riskcap-only config to finite nonnegative checks, positive width/brake/range, cap/release ordering.
contract.units_frame_dt_batch: Caps m/s; width/margins/clearances metres; reaction/TTC seconds; brake m/s^2. No integration or batch state.
contract.limits: Only receipt-bound riskcap branch, with runtime brake=2.96 unlike upstream default=2.0; not a stopping policy.

contract.name: directional_lidar_clearance
contract.input_output: (N,V,B) measured slant ranges, (B,) vehicle bearings, (N,2) commanded vehicle XY velocity and optional permitted association mask -> (N,) forward corridor clearance.
contract.units_frame_dt_batch: Metres/radians/m/s; horizontal projection cos(elevation), per-bearing minimum rows; every env independent, no dt.
contract.limits: Original pure file bitwise equality CPU float32/64; finite rows below .995 Rmax; fixed original vertical FOV convention; sparse returns do not certify complete obstacle volume.

contract.name: apply_riskcap
contract.input_output: (N,2) vehicle XY request + (N,) corridor clearance -> governed vehicle request and N-first cap/scale/TTC/stopping-margin telemetry.
contract.units_frame_dt_batch: Velocity m/s, clearance/margin metres, TTC seconds. No integration; rows independent.
contract.limits: 2 m/s is cap FLOOR, never a minimum requested/executed velocity; brake/reaction/margin affect telemetry only. Does not enforce stopping feasibility.

contract.name: point_corridor_clearance
contract.input_output: Original world XY points/validity (N,P,2)/(N,P), predicted world pose (N,K,3), yaw (N,K), vehicle request (N,K,2) -> (N,K) corridor clearance.
contract.units_frame_dt_batch: Metres/radians/m/s; subtract world translation and invert current yaw; N and K independent; no new sensor scan or integration.
contract.limits: Reprojects measured snapshot at moved poses, cannot discover unseen obstacles; explicitly ADAPTED and not raw-scan bitwise equivalence.

contract.name: rollout
contract.input_output: Normalized candidates (N,K,4), world p/v (N,3), yaw (N,), points, config and explicit H/S/dt -> Rollout records.
contract.units_frame_dt_batch: Clip normalized action, XY*2.5 m/s per axis, yaw*3 rad/s; body/vehicle command re-rotated using each current yaw. dt=.1 s, S=10 -> .01 s substep; semi-implicit world XY integration, fixed z/zero vz; N/K independent.
contract.limits: tau_v=.4 s unqualified prior, clipped acceleration 9.81 m/s^2; no actual Lee attitude/motor/altitude dynamics. Positive tau_psi requires explicit initial Euler yaw rate. H/S/dt are call arguments; safety assumes params.dt is the same decision interval used to generate Rollout.

contract.name: braking_distance
contract.input_output: Finite nonnegative speed tensor, declared knot tuple and reaction -> total distance and above-last-knot flag of same shape.
contract.units_frame_dt_batch: Speed m/s, distance metres; reaction seconds included ONCE. Below-first constant-deceleration extension, linear interpolation, above-last anchored quadratic extension. Tensor shape preserved.
contract.limits: Exact nominal knots .82/1.05/1.57 are fixed design values, not newly measured means. Extrapolation is a prior; no low-speed actual Lee calibration. Original helper remains unchanged; safety now envelopes its low-speed inconsistency.

contract.claim: Zero normalized translation plus permitted active-bearing yaw, no declared outcome.

contract.inputs: rho (N,V*B) slant metres; azimuth (B), elevation (V), yaw (N) radians; pos (N,3) world metres
contract.outputs: points (N,V*B,2) world XY metres and validity (N,V*B) bool
contract.assumptions_and_limits: Yaw-only LiDAR orientation; horizontal distance rho*cos(elevation), finite positive range strictly below .995*far is a measured hit. No surface extent or beam footprint reconstruction.
contract.time_contract: No dt advancement; consumes supplied snapshot or H-indexed rollout. Physical timing, sensor delay and latency are not independently calibrated here.
contract.qualification: LIMITED_VALIDITY: synthetic planar contract only; not 3D/sensor realism or end-to-end safety qualification

contract.inputs: points (N,P,2) world XY m; valid (N,P) bool; belief mean (N,2) m and covariance (N,2,2) m^2; target radius m and chi2 dimensionless
contract.assumptions_and_limits: ABSTAIN: beliefs cannot prove identity. All previously valid target and obstacle hits are retained. No semantic/GT input; target self-blocking remains.
contract.time_contract: No dt advancement; consumes supplied snapshot or H-indexed rollout. Physical timing, sensor delay and latency are not independently calibrated here.
contract.independent_evidence: ExclusionCounterexamples: six object-role cases plus mask/order/no-mutation
contract.qualification: LIMITED_VALIDITY: synthetic planar contract only; not 3D/sensor realism or end-to-end safety qualification

contract.inputs: broadcast segment endpoints (N,*Q,2) world XY m; measured points (N,P,2) world XY m
contract.assumptions_and_limits: Euclidean closed-segment projection with clamped [0,1] parameter; zero-length segment reduces to point distance. Assumes finite valid geometry supplied by caller.
contract.time_contract: No dt advancement; consumes supplied snapshot or H-indexed rollout. Physical timing, sensor delay and latency are not independently calibrated here.
contract.qualification: LIMITED_VALIDITY: synthetic planar contract only; not 3D/sensor realism or end-to-end safety qualification

contract.inputs: rho (N,V*B) slant m; azimuth (B) rad; pos (N,3) m, yaw (N) rad; far and horizontal margin m; optional elevations (V) rad
contract.assumptions_and_limits: Default six-argument contract is explicitly four elevations [20,10,0,-10] deg. Other layouts require elevations. Project rows before row minimum, subtract horizontal margin, then adjacent-bin minimum. Invalid/nonpositive evidence never expands a ray; no target-like far fill. Sparse-sector and 2D assumptions remain.
contract.time_contract: No dt advancement; consumes supplied snapshot or H-indexed rollout. Physical timing, sensor delay and latency are not independently calibrated here.
contract.independent_evidence: HorizontalFreeCounterexamples: 0,+/-10,+/-20 deg; before-min projection; undeclared layouts; invalid/near-zero returns
contract.qualification: LIMITED_VALIDITY: synthetic planar contract only; not 3D/sensor realism or end-to-end safety qualification

contract.inputs: relative XY queries (N,*Q,2) m; yaw (N) rad; sector radii (N,B) m; angles (B) rad
contract.assumptions_and_limits: Requires >=3 uniformly decreasing full-circle rays; nearest-ray sectors use smaller adjacent radius exactly at numerical boundary (8 machine eps). Sector interpolation is a model, not physical beam coverage.
contract.time_contract: No dt advancement; consumes supplied snapshot or H-indexed rollout. Physical timing, sensor delay and latency are not independently calibrated here.
contract.qualification: LIMITED_VALIDITY: synthetic planar contract only; not 3D/sensor realism or end-to-end safety qualification

contract.inputs: pos (N,3) m; yaw (N) rad; radii (N,B) m; far scalar m
contract.outputs: valid env mask (N) and locally sanitized pose/yaw/radii with same shapes
contract.assumptions_and_limits: Whole env invalid on any nonfinite position/yaw/radius, negative/above-far radius, or nonfinite/nonpositive far. Local zero values must always be combined with valid mask. No scan mutation.
contract.time_contract: No dt advancement; consumes supplied snapshot or H-indexed rollout. Physical timing, sensor delay and latency are not independently calibrated here.
contract.independent_evidence: ContextInputCounterexamples: point and segment checked separately with valid second env
contract.qualification: LIMITED_VALIDITY: synthetic planar contract only; not 3D/sensor realism or end-to-end safety qualification

contract.inputs: queries (N,*Q,2) world XY m and original scan pos/yaw/radii/angles/far
contract.assumptions_and_limits: Original LiDAR origin, per-env input guard, finite query, radius bound. Valid finite contexts preserve nearest-sector behavior. Does not certify unobserved inter-ray space or altitude clearance.
contract.time_contract: No dt advancement; consumes supplied snapshot or H-indexed rollout. Physical timing, sensor delay and latency are not independently calibrated here.
contract.independent_evidence: HorizontalFreeCounterexamples; ContextInputCounterexamples; sparse scan limitation fixture
contract.qualification: LIMITED_VALIDITY: synthetic planar contract only; not 3D/sensor realism or end-to-end safety qualification

contract.inputs: broadcast endpoints (N,*Q,2) world XY m; original FreeContext
contract.assumptions_and_limits: Partitions segment at sector-boundary intersections; radial convexity makes endpoint max sufficient within each sector. Exact for represented 2D radial-sector model only. Zero-length segments and invalid context guard included; no physical 3D guarantee.
contract.time_contract: No dt advancement; consumes supplied snapshot or H-indexed rollout. Physical timing, sensor delay and latency are not independently calibrated here.
contract.independent_evidence: Scalar segment examples; ContextInputCounterexamples; retained 6/5.8 negative
contract.qualification: LIMITED_VALIDITY: synthetic planar contract only; not 3D/sensor realism or end-to-end safety qualification

contract.claim: Selects live N rows; shared angles/elevations/camera calibration retained.
Clones selected explicit BOIA state rows.
Copies complete state and replaces only selected rows.
Carries each expected posterior into next F/Q prediction, not independent horizon updates.
Returns a new frozen planner; no implicit retained mutation.
Whitelist/read, live geometry/candidates/rollout/safety/sampling/forecast/cost/arbitration, fallback merge and trace.

contract.name: _segment_clearance
contract.input_output: World XY segment batches (N,...,2), points (N,P,2), validity (N,P) -> minimum sensed-point segment distance (N,...).
contract.units_frame_dt_batch: Metres, all shared world XY; element-wise difference-based distances, no matrix-distance TF32 path; N-independent, no dt.
contract.limits: Empty/all-invalid point sets give +inf; only sensed points, not obstacle surfaces, ray gaps or whole-body known-free containment.

contract.name: _stopping_envelope
contract.input_output: Final planar speed (N,K), explicit response config and actual Rollout substep count -> conservative maximum of table total and own-model continuous total.
contract.units_frame_dt_batch: Metres from m/s, seconds, m/s^2. Checks finite positive tau/a/dt and params.dt/substeps <= tau. Each N/K entry independent.
contract.limits: Continuous derivation for dv/dt=-min(v/tau,a) bounds resolved semi-implicit zero-command response; one reaction term per branch before max. No actual-plant certificate or uncertainty budget; decision interval consistency is an explicit caller precondition.

contract.name: screen
contract.input_output: Rollout (N,K,H,S,...), permitted world XY point set/validity and FreeContext -> hard_ok/stop_ok (N,K), clr_min (N,K,H), soft deficit (N,K).
contract.units_frame_dt_batch: All positions/clearances metres, velocity world m/s; speed*delay metres. Uses every initial-to-substep and substep-to-substep segment; chunks 256 segments, no cross-env reductions. Endpoint stop extends current planar velocity direction by new envelope.
contract.limits: Physical radius floor fixed for current NavRL URDF; full-body containment in known free unresolved; position/control/sensor errors NOT_RECORDED. Linear tail direction/first-order response is not actual Lee certification; finite candidate rejection does not prove unavoidable collision.

contract.claim: Pure current-terminal-row BOIA reset; never writes simulator or tracker.
Derives immutable SHA constants from deterministic integer primes.
Integer cube root for exact SHA fractional-cube-root constants.
Standard SHA-256 padding,32bit schedule/rounds,32byte output.
8-byte big-endian payload length followed by bytes.
Framed tuple values and typed ASCII primitives; floats use exact logical float.hex.
Versioned per-field framing of only copied OnlineInputs, global sensor angles and camera calibration.
Exports only live rows and independent copies; no post-reset digest or evaluator label.

contract.name: BoiaParams.__post_init__
contract.input_output: Frozen scalar priors to validated record; no state or sensor reads.
contract.units_frame_dt_batch: Counts H/S/M/K; dt/tau/t_det/t_react seconds, radius/distances metres, a_max m/s^2; weights/thresholds dimensionless. Config is shared explicitly across N; no global mutable state.
contract.limits: Only explicit positive finite tau_on, nonnegative declared r_bar_est, p_miss range and positive H/S/M/K/dt are checked here; this is not complete semantic validation or calibration. Added safety consumer validates its geometry, response and discretization requirements.

contract.claim: Finite positive-forward pinhole FOV and radial far gate.

contract.inputs: camera-frame vectors (...,3) m; hfov/vfov rad; radial max range m
contract.outputs: bool (...), forward x and finite vectors
contract.assumptions_and_limits: Yaw-only pinhole centre FOV and Euclidean radial range. Exact floating boundaries have no numerical tolerance; silhouette/partial visibility and exposure effects are not represented.
contract.time_contract: No dt advancement; consumes supplied snapshot or H-indexed rollout. Physical timing, sensor delay and latency are not independently calibrated here.
contract.qualification: LIMITED_VALIDITY: synthetic planar contract only; not 3D/sensor realism or end-to-end safety qualification

contract.claim: Point-disc segment clearance plus optional mandatory known-free segment containment.

contract.inputs: explicit start/end (N,*Q,2) world XY m; obstacle points (N,P,2) m; valid mask; disc radius m; optional original FreeContext
contract.assumptions_and_limits: Point-disc segment clearance and optionally original scan-sector coverage. Caller must provide optical origin for camera LOS; no height, silhouette, material/transparency, rolling shutter or new-depth synthesis.
contract.time_contract: No dt advancement; consumes supplied snapshot or H-indexed rollout. Physical timing, sensor delay and latency are not independently calibrated here.
contract.independent_evidence: Camera-origin scalar oracle and retained 6/5.8 negative; geometry scalar-distance check
contract.qualification: LIMITED_VALIDITY: synthetic planar contract only; not 3D/sensor realism or end-to-end safety qualification

contract.claim: Rotates world relative vector to yaw-only V and subtracts camera offset.

contract.inputs: world-relative vectors (N,*Q,3) m; yaw (N,*prefix) rad; declared yaw-frame camera offset m
contract.outputs: camera-relative vectors with same shape, m
contract.assumptions_and_limits: Inverse yaw rotation then subtract camera offset exactly once. Roll/pitch and full SE(3) calibration are not modeled.
contract.time_contract: No dt advancement; consumes supplied snapshot or H-indexed rollout. Physical timing, sensor delay and latency are not independently calibrated here.
contract.independent_evidence: IndependentHelperChecks scalar +90deg rotation/offset; rotated LOS fixture
contract.qualification: LIMITED_VALIDITY: synthetic planar contract only; not 3D/sensor realism or end-to-end safety qualification

contract.claim: Coordinated P0 patch: world optical centre p_xy+R_yaw offset_xy; excludes vertical LOS guarantee.

contract.inputs: ego position (N,*Q,3) world m; yaw (N,*Q) rad; camera offset in vehicle yaw frame m
contract.assumptions_and_limits: Added minimal B02 fix: p_ego,XY + R_yaw*camera_offset,XY. Vertical offset is not a planar LOS certificate. Does not alter original LiDAR free-set origin.
contract.time_contract: No dt advancement; consumes supplied snapshot or H-indexed rollout. Physical timing, sensor delay and latency are not independently calibrated here.
contract.independent_evidence: Scalar (0.1,0) optical origin and +90deg rotated counterexample
contract.qualification: LIMITED_VALIDITY: synthetic planar contract only; not 3D/sensor realism or end-to-end safety qualification

contract.claim: Loops candidate/time with shared target paths and fixed point/free sets; oracle or stressed gate.

contract.inputs: ego rollout (N,K,H,3) world m; yaw (N,K,H) rad; target sample paths (N,M,H,6) [m,m/s]; obstacle points, free context, camera and explicit priors
contract.assumptions_and_limits: Uses original static point map, optical-origin LOS, yaw-only camera and projected-area gate. Oracle means this declared geometry model, not simulator GT. Stress p_miss/beta/n0 are explicit uncalibrated priors. Uses params r_T/min_pixels; caller must match camera calibration. No online GT.
contract.time_contract: No dt advancement; consumes supplied snapshot or H-indexed rollout. Physical timing, sensor delay and latency are not independently calibrated here.
contract.independent_evidence: Base false-clear versus independent scalar oracle; corrected optical origin and no-double-offset tests; retained negative
contract.qualification: LIMITED_VALIDITY: synthetic planar contract only; not 3D/sensor realism or end-to-end safety qualification

contract.claim: Mean across paths of within-path1-product(1-p); temporal independence conditional assumption.

contract.assumptions_and_limits: First product/union within each sampled trajectory, then average over M. Within-path Bernoulli draw independence is a stress-model assumption; geometry 0/1 case is deterministic. Not union of separately averaged marginals.
contract.time_contract: No dt advancement; consumes supplied snapshot or H-indexed rollout. Physical timing, sensor delay and latency are not independently calibrated here.
contract.qualification: LIMITED_VALIDITY: synthetic planar contract only; not 3D/sensor realism or end-to-end safety qualification

contract.claim: Linear Gaussian signed-margin probability, deterministic branch at zero variance.

contract.inputs: signed margin g m; gradient dimensionless; symmetric PSD covariance m^2; optional strict boolean boundary
contract.outputs: linearized Gaussian clearance probability with g shape
contract.assumptions_and_limits: Gradient covariance contraction and scalar normal CDF. Valid PSD covariance is caller contract; numerical negative variance clamped to zero. Deterministic zero-variance boundary uses strict forward gate where requested.
contract.time_contract: No dt advancement; consumes supplied snapshot or H-indexed rollout. Physical timing, sensor delay and latency are not independently calibrated here.
contract.independent_evidence: IndependentHelperChecks scalar erf oracle at variance4, g=-1/0/1; strict zero-variance case
contract.qualification: LIMITED_VALIDITY: synthetic planar contract only; not 3D/sensor realism or end-to-end safety qualification

contract.claim: Linearizes one active FOV margin and point-disc clear events, then independent product.

contract.inputs: ego (N,*Q,3) m; yaw (N,*Q) rad; target mean (N,3) m; covariance (N,3,3) m^2; measured points/valid/radius; camera
contract.assumptions_and_limits: Fixed-ego, active-margin FOV/size/range linearization and independent point-disc clearance products. B02 corrected optical-origin mean segment and its derivative. Unknown-space probability omitted by design; forecast comparison requires declared model alignment. Uses cam target_radius/min_pixels (caller must match params).
contract.time_contract: No dt advancement; consumes supplied snapshot or H-indexed rollout. Physical timing, sensor delay and latency are not independently calibrated here.
contract.independent_evidence: Base false-clear versus scalar geometry; corrected zero-covariance optical-origin result; normal-CDF helper oracle
contract.qualification: LIMITED_VALIDITY: synthetic planar contract only; not 3D/sensor realism or end-to-end safety qualification
